name: Ketgrinn

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.text: The ketgrinn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.summary: Imitates any voice it has heard or stolen; a DC 14 Wis (Insight) check spots it (DC 19 for a stolen voice).
traits.text: The ketgrinn can copy any voice it has heard, including one it has stolen with Consume Voice. A listener who succeeds on a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check knows it is an imitation; for a stolen voice the DC is 19.

traits.name: Riddle Bound
traits.summary: Influence action: pose it a riddle and succeed on a DC 16 Cha (Deception) check and it is Incapacitated until the start of your next turn; each riddle raises the DC by 1 for 24 hours.
traits.text: As an Influence action a creature can put a riddle to the ketgrinn and make a DC 16 Charisma (Deception) check. On a success the ketgrinn is Incapacitated until the start of that creature's next turn. Each riddle asked raises the DC of later riddles by 1 for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Claw attacks; one may be Consume Voice instead.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +6, 2d4+4 Slashing plus 2d6 Psychic; the target has Disadvantage on the next save the ketgrinn makes it roll before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

actions.name: Consume Voice
actions.summary: One creature within 5 ft, DC 14 Cha save: 4d8 Psychic (half on a success) and its voice is stolen, so it can't speak or make a sound; it saves again each turn, and three failures make the loss last until the ketgrinn dies.
actions.text: While its voice is stolen the target cannot speak or make any verbal sound. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success; if it fails three of these saves the loss is permanent, and the voice returns only when the ketgrinn dies.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.summary: Casts Invisibility on itself (Cha, no components).

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.summary: Teleports up to 40 ft to an unoccupied space it can see.

summary: A grinning cat-fey that scratches with psychic claws, steals voices, blinks away and slips out of sight; a hard riddle sends its mind spinning.
